verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is BILL's marketing claim that its cards come with spend management so "every transaction is controlled" and "automatically compliant", plus API docs for setting up budgets and virtual cards. That implies some card-level spend controls, but nothing describes specific restriction types or point-of-sale enforcement. Missing for 10: documented restrictions by merchant category, by specific merchant, and by per-transaction amount; evidence of automatic decline or card lock at the point of sale; any hands-on or independent corroboration.
